title: Naxos course coverage and evidence methods
details: Naxos-created course packs can deliberately leave source KSBs or ACs unused for pathway-specific courses
Unused source codes no longer prevent a Naxos-created course pack from being installed in Evia
Learner course progress is calculated from the codes actually published into that course or pathway, so deliberately excluded codes do not make 100% impossible
Naxos evidence tiles can carry Photo, Video or Audio as their chosen evidence method
Photo evidence opens the photo route, Video opens the video route, and Audio opens the talk/record route
Existing course packs without the new Naxos settings keep their existing behaviour
No learner evidence or existing course data is removed
summary: Evia v220 adds compatibility for Naxos coverage audits, intentional pathway omissions and author-selected evidence methods while preserving existing courses.
changes: Added v220 version marker and offline cache
Kept legacy course-pack validation unchanged unless the Naxos allow-unmapped flag is present
